title: Ordinary sections coherence with independent coefficient universes
statement: For a preorder-indexed compatible tower of commutative ring sheaves and coefficient rings, with coefficient rings allowed a smaller universe than sheaf sections, ordinary sheaf scalar extensions specified on objects and morphisms, and a pure-tensor normalized sections comparison, there exists a unique family of sheaf and module associators and action units satisfying the balanced formulas, their inverse formulas, the sections square, the identity square, and both four-stage associativity equations. Repeated indices are allowed. The section functor is evaluation at the specified terminal object followed by scalar restriction.

source.place: Tags 03EK, 03CZ, 03CY; ordinary portion of lem-weil-sections-scalar-cochain-coherence, proof steps 1--4 and 6--8

proof.text: Use extension/restriction adjunctions to construct the unique sheaf associators. The units insert 1 tensor x. Transposing twice gives c tensor (b tensor x) mapped to f(b)c tensor x, with inverse inserting 1. Construct the module maps by the identical ordinary tensor adjunction.
The normalized sections comparisons take double pure tensors to the same product of coefficients by lambda compatibility. Tensor generation gives the square. The identity case gives its unit version.

Both routes on three nested tensors multiply coefficients in the same order. Associativity proves the four-stage equations. Repeated use of the sheaf extension adjunction, rather than an assertion of global tensor generation, proves equality and uniqueness on sheaves.
